boundary_rule: Exactly one top-level titled work maps to exactly one TEI. Each of the 39 source books remains nested under that work. No book member is split into a TEI document.
checks: all 39 primary-source members are present in the exact profiled order and match their authority hashes
all three support members match their authority hashes and receive an explicit support-only disposition
the candidate contains exactly one TEI root and one Tanakh work div
all 39 books appear exactly once in canonical source order as children of the work
each book's chapter divisions preserve source chapter order and labels
all 25,239 source lines, 929 chapter markers, and 23,145 verse markers have exactly one ordered source-line carrier
candidate TEI passes the bound vendored TEI P5 XSD
source accounting, provenance, and unresolved print-collation status match independently derived facts
two resealed source-line/book-boundary mutations are rejected by the oracle
two clean current-process reconstructions reproduce all six package files and validation sidecar bytes

identity.edition_year_basis: The active L229 source designation identifies the 1853 Leeser Hebrew Bible; exact print collation remains open.

limits: The candidate represents the exact electronic source envelope, not a complete-print-edition claim.
The physical 1853 printing has not been collated.
Validation and mechanical source correspondence do not establish human acceptance, rights clearance, or publication authorization.
line_validation: Independent oracle reads every source line in member order and compares exact text, line number, source pointer, preservation-space flag, book placement, and chapter grouping to the readable TEI.

source.selected_text_members: all 39 ordered members named book_members in the bound reconstruction profile
source.support_members: all three named support members are separately retained and hashed; none are converted as body text
